matching_rules: The square campaign matches horizontal and vertical runs of three or more among five kinds. Four in a line leave a line gem of that color and five a rainbow gem. Chains absorb their hit before the plaque clears. One bonus family at a time occupies a piece slot, and each socket holds one use.

campaign_pieces.states: One authored sprite per match kind. Selection, hints, chains, press and motion use the existing board overlays and transforms.
campaign_pieces.registration: Crop revised pieces from their named boxes, then fill remaining base sprites from the original columns and row bands. Trim the transparent exterior, fit and center each object.

bonus_gems.registration: Center the visible board pieces on 128 px cells. The default fit is 112 px; Hammer fits 100 px and Lightning fits 94 px. Round buttons use each frame's center of opacity, with Hammer centered by its silhouette bounds in lua/art.lua.

bomb.effect: Hit a cell and its six neighbors.

shield.effect: Hit the row through a chosen cell.

lightning.effect: Strike up to fifteen random cells.

plus.effect: Choose a resource piece for 100 resources or another bonus to add a quarter charge.

star.effect: Clear all pieces of a chosen kind.
